title: Unlocking AI in Your Apps with TanStack AI
partialText: TanStack AI is a strongly typed set of libraries for adding AI features to your apps. Part 1 of this intro covers basic setup and prompting, streaming responses, persisting threads to your database, and resuming a response after a mid-stream refresh.

title: SVG “Linked Parameters” Will Change How We Do Icon Systems
partialText: Maybe we can get back to an img-based icon system?

title: Building a Fancy Scrollspy Using Modern CSS
partialText: Scrollspy navigation used to mean IntersectionObserver and a pile of JavaScript. With scroll-target-group, :target-current, and a little anchor positioning, a plain list of anchor links can highlight the current section all on its own.

title: 5 Good Choices for HTML Containers
partialText: Divs and spans are fine, but purposefully meaningless. Often the meaning actually matters, so let's look at some of those situations.

title: How an accessibility designer adds keyboard shortcuts to a web app
partialText: Eric Bailey explains the thinking and research that go into adding just a few custom keyboard shortcuts to a web app. There’s an absolute ton to consider and test, and plenty of challenges can come from your own team.

title: Testing an iframe’s postMessage Handler
partialText: There are some real complexities using iframes and the postMessage API for communication between a widget and its parent. Security vulnerabilities like cross-origin scripting risks being one.
